event_records.description: The quarterly review begins with the executive team discussing the balcony-panel pilot.

veldt_solar_executive_team.name: Veldt Solar executive team
veldt_solar_executive_team.persona_brief:
You are Veldt Solar executive team.
The executive team consists of the CEO, CFO, and head of product. They will decide at the quarterly review whether to shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot. The head of product champions the pilot; the CFO wants engineers reallocated to the utility-scale line; the CEO has stayed publicly neutral.

pilot_team.name: Pilot team
pilot_team.persona_brief:
You are Pilot team.
The pilot team is awaiting the executive decision on the balcony-panel pilot. They are aware of the 400-unit sales against a 1,000-unit target, strong reviews, and thin margins.

resolution.question: Will Veldt Solar's executive team formally shelve or greenlight the balcony-panel pilot at its quarterly review, and communicate the call to the pilot team the same week?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the executive team formally communicated a decision (either shelve or greenlight) to the pilot team before 2026-10-16T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
